Researchers examined how different types of music influence agitation levels in patients in the early stages of Alzheimer’s disease. Each patient listened to three genres of music — classical, heavy metal, and K‑pop — and agitation levels were recorded (higher scores = more agitation). 

The following quiz will be based of this scenario.
